# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.3

<!-- update-summary: 修复中文曲名和歌词候选匹配；优先采用现成译文，额外查找最多等待 1.5 秒；增强音乐光效响应，并复用验证过的安装包缩短发布流程。 -->

## Fixes and improvements

- Chinese lyrics matching now handles soundtrack descriptions, stacked featured-artist/language decorations and corroborated Chinese/English catalogue titles. Artist, duration and conflicting-version safeguards remain enforced.
- NetEase and QQ inspect bounded distinct candidates; an empty or original-only first candidate no longer hides an available matching translated candidate.
- Existing target-language translations take priority within configured sources. The remaining-source option expands that scope. A single 1.5-second supplemental search budget starts at the first usable original; timeout keeps original lyrics visible. Failed/incomplete provider searches do not falsely trigger AI as proof of missing translations.
- Music-reactive glow gains local audio contrast so compressed/loud tracks retain visible variation. Accepted geometry and palette are retained; no global high-refresh loop is introduced.
- Publication promotes successful identical-tree CI packages with byte/provenance validation, avoiding repeated compilation and tests. Unchanged reviewed native runtime bytes are reused only with valid source-bound authorization.

## Evidence and limitations

QQ catalogue matching and real-response parsing were checked for 饭卡《零》 and HOYO-MiX / 孙晔《风的来信》. One live full-pipeline request returned the latter's 52 lines; the former's actual separately retrieved responses replayed through the production service yielded 119 lines. Cloud live requests also experienced timeouts; replay is not proof of every real-network or Windows presentation outcome. See docs/dev/beta3-lyrics-investigation.md.

AI remains optional and off by default. The same pinned Hy-MT2 1.8B and optional 7B Q8 models, prompts and 600-second processing ceiling are retained. Models remain unverified and semanticApproved=false; provider/matching fixes do not qualify model semantics or infer new native-model passes. Previously disclosed unverified GPU, present-FPS and additional local visual/input acceptance remain limitations. This is an experimental Beta, not a Stable exception.

## Compatibility

Semantic version: 0.3.1-beta.3. PE/MSIX version: 0.3.1.3. v0.3.1-beta.2 is the immediate upgrade baseline and remains immutable. Stable remains v0.2.1. Download and install manually from the official website or release page.

## 中文说明

重点修复中文曲名匹配、首条候选无歌词导致漏查、已有译文未优先采用的问题。找到原歌词后，寻找现成译文最多额外等待 1.5 秒，所有候选和来源共用预算，超时保留原歌词。增强普通及高响度歌曲的音乐光效响应，保留已认可的造型与配色。发布复用通过检查的同源安装包，减少重复构建。
模型和提示词未更换，AI 歌词仍为可选 Beta，模型语义质量未获完整验证。真实网络超时仍可能发生。
